statement: SDL3 PS4 HIDAPI's enhanced mode is selected by user hint and application usage; Bluetooth may begin in simple mode, calibration GET on official controllers may activate advanced reports, and a dummy output path is used to trigger enhanced mode when authorized.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_ps4.c 274–351, 684–789, 835–896. This is SDL's policy and not all apps or transports use enhanced input.
